data.title: Spacewalk a first for French female astronaut
data.description: WASHINGTON - Sophie Adenot is set to become the first French female astronaut to venture outside the International Space Station for a spacewalk on Tuesday, accompanied by American astronaut Anil Menon.

data.title: Immobilised Japan fighter jet leads to runway closure at Okinawa airport
data.description: A runway was closed at Naha Airport in the southern island prefecture of Okinawa on Tuesday after a Japanese Self-Defense Forces fighter jet became immobilized following landing, according to the transport ministry.

data.title: More Trump-Kim 'love'? What we know about North Korea
data.description: SEOUL - United States President Donald Trump says Kim Jong Un had responded to his recent overtures and praised his relationship with the North Korean leader a day after scaling back military drills with South Korea.

data.title: Major Meta trial begins as lawyers spar over witnesses, damages
data.description: OAKLAND — Facebook-parent Meta will defend itself in a landmark social media trial that begins Tuesday in California, where attorneys have sparred over witnesses and financial penalties.

data.title: Make it rain: Indonesia chases clouds to stem El Nino fires
data.description: PALANGKARAYA — Indonesia's Borneo, home to pristine rainforest and protected species, is burning. Meteorologist Safillah Anggie Wahyuni hopes a solution lies in the clouds.

data.title: Transylvania's fortified churches face fragile future
data.description: MOşNA (ROMANIA) - Built in the Middle Ages to provide shelter from attacks, Transylvania's fortified churches risk crumbling despite efforts to preserve and breathe new life into them.

data.title: Japan stresses 'critical cooperation' as Trump slashes S.Korea drills
data.description: SEOUL - Japan underlined on Tuesday that security cooperation with the United States and South Korea was "critical" for the region's stability, after President Donald Trump alarmed allies by scaling back military drills with Seoul while hailing his ties with Pyongyang.

data.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it gets in way of Iran deal
data.description: WASHINGTON - President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to bomb Oman if it "gets in the way" of a US deal with Iran on the Strait of Hormuz and called for Tehran to surrender in a war that has become a growing political burden.

data.title: Hundreds hospitalised in Yangon cholera outbreak
data.description: YANGON — Some 500 people have been hospitalised for severe diarrhoea in Myanmar's largest city, a Yangon official said on Monday, with nearly 150 testing positive for cholera.

data.title: China mourns former premier Zhu Rongji with flags lowered, funeral
data.description: BEIJING — Former Chinese premier Zhu Rongji was mourned on Tuesday with lowered flags and social media commemorations, ahead of a funeral for the reforming trailblazer who died last week at 97.

data.title: Two killed in high school shooting in southern Philippines
data.description: MANILA — Two people ​were killed in a shooting at a high ​school in the southern ‌Philippines on Tuesday and the situation was now under control, officials said, in the second such incident in the country in nearly two months.

data.title: Elderly far more at risk from rising heat than thought: study
data.description: PARIS - The threat that rising temperatures fuelled by climate change pose to the health of older people has been dramatically underestimated, according to a US modelling study published Tuesday.

data.title: Zambia's Hichilema wins re-election with 60% of vote
data.description: LUSAKA - Zambia's President Hakainde Hichilema won re-election with around 60 percent of votes cast last week, the electoral commission announced Tuesday, after a race critics said was tightly managed by his government.

data.title: Whales spark joy in New York but face threats from boat traffic
data.description: NEW YORK - "WHALE AT ONE O'CLOCK!"

data.title: US pauses construction of border project in Texas national park
data.description: HOUSTON - President Donald Trump's administration said Monday it had paused construction on a $1.7 billion border project at Big Bend National Park in Texas that has faced fierce local opposition across party lines.

data.title: Colombian minister under fire over beach holiday post-quake
data.description: BOGOTá - Colombia's new housing minister has come under fire after it emerged that he took his family on a Caribbean holiday while the country was reeling from a devastating earthquake that left thousands homeless.

data.title: Tupac Shakur's accused killer was out for 'revenge', jury hears
data.description: LAS VEGAS - Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in an act of gang revenge ordered by a mobster who later boasted of it, jurors heard Monday, as one of America's most anticipated trials got under way, 30 years after the murder.

data.title: Discord suspends livestreams in Brazil after teen's suicide
data.description: BRASíLIA - Popular messaging platform Discord said Monday that it had complied with a Brazilian government order to suspend livestreaming and video calls in the country after a teen girl was allegedly goaded into taking her own life during one such broadcast.

data.title: Trump threatens Oman: latest developments in US-Iran war
data.description: DUBAI - US President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to bomb Oman, 60 days after the signing of a memorandum of understanding towards a peace deal to end the war between the United States and Iran.

data.title: 'Never seen one like it': German pensioners flee wildfire
data.description: MONSCHAU - German pensioner Petra Mertens did not hesitate when ordered to evacuate her home in the sleepy western border town of Monschau in Germany as an enormous fire advanced from neighbouring Belgium.

data.title: Cambridge head slams 'feeding frenzy' over dead academic
data.description: LONDON - The head of Cambridge university Monday condemned a "racist feeding frenzy" prompted by plagiarism claims against black academic Jason Arday, as his supporters prepared for a London vigil after his death last week.

data.title: UN laments 'unacceptable' toll of 350 aid workers killed in 2025
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The number of aid workers killed worldwide in 2025 reached 350, with the most fatalities in Gaza and Sudan, the United Nations (UN) said Monday, calling attacks on humanitarians "unacceptable."

data.title: Cambodian opposition figure's daughter appointed PM's envoy in rare concession
data.description: PHNOM PENH — ⁠The ⁠daughter of a recently pardoned ​Cambodian opposition figure who was jailed for alleged treason has been ​appointed special envoy to Prime ‌Minister Hun Manet, a royal decree showed on Monday, in a rare concession to the political opposition.

data.title: Taiwan's leader says government to propose record defence spending for 2027
data.description: TAIPEI - Taiwan's government will propose record defence spending for 2027, President Lai Ching-te said on Monday, as the island democracy faces growing military pressure from China.

data.title: Ebola outbreak now DR Congo's deadliest ever
data.description: KINSHASA - A fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the country's deadliest ever after government figures showed it killed more than 2,300 people in three months.

data.title: Rain brings respite as Belgium wrestles massive wildfire
data.description: ROBERTVILLE (BELGIUM) — Much-needed rain brought some respite Monday to firefighters on their fourth day battling Belgium's worst wildfire in a century, which has scorched vast expanses of nature reserve on the German border.

data.title: Jinny Lu, the world’s ugliest dog, proves that looks aren’t everything
data.description: NEW YORK — Ugly is subjective. But in this competition, it means everything.

data.title: Australia's mushroom murderer appeals conviction
data.description: SYDNEY - Australian toxic mushroom killer Erin Patterson launches an appeal Wednesday against her conviction in a triple-murder case that made headlines worldwide.

data.title: Winning back walls from gangs, artists fill El Salvador's towns with colour
data.description: CONCEPCION DE ATACO (EL SALVADOR) - On the walls where gang members in El Salvador once marked their turf, urban artists are now creating large murals in a traveling festival that fills the streets of the Central American country with colour.

data.title: Photos, memories all that remain for Colombia's bereaved after quake
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - In Torres del Limonar, a Cali residential complex that collapsed in Monday's earthquake, people pick through rubble to recover victims' belongings and return them to grieving families.

data.title: Sabbath cafe clash lays bare Israel faultlines
data.description: JERUSALEM - Alma Ronen has been fighting in the Israeli military nearly constantly for more than two years. Spending her Saturday not in uniform but in a T-shirt and jeans, she would like to enjoy a coffee outside -- and resents that her more religious compatriots think otherwise.

data.title: As machinery removes rubble, hopes for survivors from Colombian quake dwindle
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - The noise of backhoes, cranes and bulldozers echoed across Colombia's quake-hit cities on Sunday as workers labored to remove rubble, though the chance of finding survivors was slim a week after the disaster.

data.title: Nearly 13,000 displaced by deadly Indonesian quake
data.description: MBAY, Indonesia - Thousands of people displaced by a powerful earthquake in eastern Indonesia awaited much-needed aid on Monday as they camped out at schools, police stations and government offices, with many stuck outside.

data.title: Trump says US scaling back military drills with South Korea
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said he was "not happy" about US participation in joint military exercises with close ally South Korea and is scaling back the drills aimed at deterring rival North Korea that start Monday.

data.title: Hamas expects meeting with Kushner as US pushes Gaza plan
data.description: CAIRO - Hamas sources said on Sunday that they expected to meet in Egypt with US envoy Jared Kushner, as President Donald Trump's administration seeks to push forward a Gaza peace plan rejected by Israel.

data.title: Europe wildfires: latest developments
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Two people died when fires broke out on a Greek island, and Belgium was tackling a record blaze in its east Sunday, as Europe faced wildfires spurred by high temperatures and tinder-dry conditions.

data.title: Air support kicks in as record Belgian wildfire jumps in size
data.description: BAELEN (BELGIUM) - Crucial air support swung into action Sunday to help firefighters tame Belgium's largest modern-day wildfire, which has mushroomed in size since breaking out two days ago in a hard-to-access nature reserve.
